user.title: Fitness (fitbridge)
user.description: Adds the Fitness page to the sidebar and scores the household's workouts.

menu_options.viewers: Who is who and step sensors

viewers.title: Who is who
viewers.description: Pick the fitbridge person for each Home Assistant user. Users set to Nobody see the household read-only.

steps.title: Step sensors
steps.description: Pick each person's daily steps sensor, for example from the phone's companion app. Leave it empty for no steps.

opengym.title: Pair with openGym
opengym.description: Enter openGym's address and a pairing code made in openGym's admin settings. Fitness exchanges the code for a token and keeps renewing it.

people.title: openGym users
people.description: Pick each person's openGym user; their gym sessions count as workouts. Leave Nobody for a person without openGym.

inputs.title: Webhooks and watch folders

mode.title: Shadow mode
mode.description: In shadow mode fitbridge on the LXC stays the live system: Fitness scores silently into /config/fitbridge/shadow-scores.json, creates no sensors or events, and the page keeps the LXC's scores. Turn it off to switch to Fitness (stop the LXC's fitbridge first); turn it on to go back.

abort.waiting_for_fitbridge: Waiting for fitbridge: no scores have arrived over MQTT yet. Try again once fitbridge has published.
abort.cannot_connect: openGym could not be reached, or it rejected the token. Pair with openGym again if this persists.

error.invalid_code: openGym did not accept this pairing code. Codes are 4 to 16 letters and digits; make a new one in openGym if it expired.
error.cannot_connect: openGym could not be reached at this address.
error.folder_missing: This folder does not exist. Give its full path, for example /share/opentracks.

opengym_token.title: openGym rejected the token
opengym_token.description: fitbridge could not read openGym because the token was rejected. Gym sessions come from the last good fetch until fitbridge is paired with openGym again.

old_entities.title: Old fitness entities are in the way
old_entities.description: Fitness is not in shadow mode, but another integration (MQTT, from fitbridge on the LXC) still has entity ids the fitness sensors and events need, such as the sensor.fit_… sensors or event.fit_record_set. Until they are gone, Fitness scores for its page but creates no entities and announces nothing. Stop the LXC's fitbridge so it clears its MQTT entities (or delete them), then reload Fitness.

folder_missing.title: Watch folder for {person} is missing
folder_missing.description: Fitness cannot find {folder}, the watch folder for {person}, so it is not scanned. Other inputs go on. Restore the folder, or change or clear it in the Fitness options (Webhooks and watch folders).

remove_workout.name: Remove workout
remove_workout.description: Leaves a workout out of scoring; a workout logged by hand is deleted.

person.name: Person
person.description: The fitbridge person, as in scoring.toml (for example person1).

key.name: Workout key
key.description: The workout's key, as the Recent sensor and the page show it.

indoor.name: Indoor
indoor.description: Indoor, for example on a treadmill.

carry_over_shoes.name: Carry over shoes
carry_over_shoes.description: Copies each person's Endurain shoes (the ones chosen earlier in the options) into Fitness: same name and replace-at distance, each person's earlier runs on their first shoe, and the distance Endurain shows kept. Safe to run twice.
